Declare
 t_status varchar2(6);
 t_customer_id consignee.customer_id%type;
 t_plasma_file_type customers.plasma_file_type%type;
 t_delimiter vserv_master.code_desc%type;
Begin 
 -- The following statements added by Edwin for XML Doc generation 
 go_item('ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no');

 IF nvl(:ctrl_blk.shipment_no,' ') = nvl(:ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no,' ') and
 :ctrl_blk.consignee_id is not null then 

 show_error_dist('4103');
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2014. SCR 20597
 begin
 select customer_id
 into t_customer_id
 from consignee
 where consignee_id = :ctrl_blk.consignee_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_customer_id := null;
 show_error_dist('1300');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if t_customer_id is not null then
 begin
 select plasma_file_type
 into t_plasma_file_type
 from customers
 where customer_id = t_customer_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error_dist('0302');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 show_error_dist('6600');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 begin
 select code_desc
 into t_delimiter
 from vserv_master
 where code_type = 'CSLFL'
 and code = 'DELIM'
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error_dist('1521');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if nvl(upper(t_plasma_file_type), '*') = 'XML' then
 xml_generator.gen_edn_xml(:ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no, t_status);
 elsif nvl(upper(t_plasma_file_type), '*') = 'CSL' then
 lt_plasma_csl_file_generator.gen_csl_file(:ctrl_blk.s_shipment_no, t_delimiter, t_status);
 else
 show_error_dist('9938');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 --XML_GENERATOR.GEN_EDN_XML(:s_shipment_no, t_status); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2014. SCR 20597

 -- This Shell script will move the file to the NT server 
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 if t_status='OK' then 
 if nvl(upper(t_plasma_file_type), '*') = 'XML' then -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2014. SCR 20597
 host ('XMLGEN.sh '||:s_shipment_no||'.xml', NO_SCREEN);
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2014. SCR 20597
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id:=:GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 show_error_dist('4016');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif t_status='NOTOK' then
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id:=:GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 show_error_dist('4102');
 check_package_failure;
 else --This condition will be true if log file has any problems
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id:=:GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 show_error_dist(t_status);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 Else
 show_error_dist('4306');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;
End;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Generate_XML_DOC(pl_Ship_No in Varchar2) IS

 /***********************************************************************************************************************************************
 Developed By : Basker Edwin
 Date :06.10.2002
 Purpose : This procedure will create an XML file with the elements and attributes as per the given DTD(Document Type Definition)
 The DTD name is UT100.dtd. The Generated file will be automatically sent to the BCA
********************************************************************************************************************************************** */


 in_file Text_IO.File_Type;

 Cursor Ship_cur is Select * from shipments where shipment_no=pl_Ship_No;
 Cursor Carton_cur is Select * from boxes where shipment_no=pl_Ship_No;
 Cursor Unit_cur(plCarton_id in varchar2) is Select * from pick_slip_products where box_id=plCarton_id;

 szShipDate VARCHAR2(15);
 szXMLDir VARCHAR2(40); 
 szXMLFile VARCHAR2(75);
 szXmlVersion VARCHAR2(100); 
 szDocType VARCHAR2(100); 
 szNoteEle VARCHAR2(200);
 szShipEle VARCHAR2(200);
 szCartonEle VARCHAR2(200);
 szUnitEle VARCHAR2(200);
 szCartonEndTag VARCHAR2(100);
 szShipEndtag VARCHAR2(100);
 szNoteEndtag VARCHAR2(100);
 szShipIdentifier VARCHAR2(21);
 szCenter VARCHAR2(40); 
 szFraction VARCHAR2(40);
 szConsignee VARCHAR2(40);
 szAboRh VARCHAR2(10);
 szAbo VARCHAR2(15);
 szRh VARCHAR2(15); 
 szWeight NUMBER(5,2);
 szTestedAbo VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN


 ---Get the Directory from the Master code table

 begin
 select code_desc into szXMLDir from vserv_master where
 code_type='XMLDR' and code='XMLDR' and rownum =1;
 exception when others then
 message(sqlerrm||': File creation directory is not specified');
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 -- Create a file name which is similar to the shipment no with xml extension

szXMLFile:=pl_ship_no||'.xml';
szXMLfile:=szXMLDir||szXMLfile;

 --- Get the Shipment Information
 For Ship_rec in Ship_cur Loop
 szShipDate:=To_Char(Ship_rec.shipment_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'); 
 szConsignee:=Ship_rec.consignee_id; 
 select customer_id into szFraction from consignee where consignee_id=Ship_rec.consignee_id and rownum=1;
 End loop;

 -- Get the center
Begin
 select inst_id into szCenter from institutions where rownum =1;
Exception when no_data_found then 
 szCenter:='UnKnkwn';
End;

 -- Open a Xml file with( a file with .xml extension)

 in_file := Text_IO.Fopen(szXMLFile, 'a');

szXmlVersion:='<?xml version='|| '"1.0"' ||' encoding=' || '"UTF-8"?>'; 

szDocType:='<!DOCTYPE Note SYSTEM '||'"U9100.dtd">';

szNoteEle :='<Note Created_date='||'"'||szShipDate||'"'||' Identifier='||'"'||pl_Ship_No||'"'||' Version='||'"1.0">';

szShipIdentifier:=to_char(sysdate,'mmddrr')||substr(pl_ship_no,-4);
szShipEle :='<Shipment center='||'"'||szCenter||'"'|| ' identifier='||'"'||szShipIdentifier||'"'||' fractionator='||'"'||szFraction||'"'||' consignee='||'"'||szConsignee||'"'||
 ' ship_date='||'"'||szShipDate||'">';
szShipEle:=Lpad(szShipEle,NVL(Length(szShipEle), 0)+5,'X');
szShipEle:=Translate(szShipEle,'X',' ');

Text_IO.Put_Line(in_file, szXmlVersion);
--Text_IO.Put_Line(in_file, szDocType);
Text_IO.Put_Line(in_file, szNoteEle);
Text_IO.Put_Line(in_file, szShipEle);

-- Loop for boxes(Cartons)

For Carton_rec in Carton_cur Loop

 szCartonEle:='<Carton carton_type='|| '"CA" identifier='||'"'||Carton_rec.box_id||'"'||' pack_date='||'"'||to_char(Carton_rec.packed_date,'yyyy-mm-dd')||'">';
 szCartonEle:=Lpad(szCartonEle,NVL(Length(szCartonEle), 0)+9,'X');
 szCartonEle:=Translate(szCartonEle,'X',' ');
 Text_IO.Put_Line(in_file, szCartonEle);

 ---Take the units one by one(Loop for each units)

 for unit_rec in unit_cur(carton_rec.box_id) Loop
 -- Get the tested abo code from UTRS table
 select result_status_1 into szTestedAbo from UTRS where unit_id=unit_rec.unit_id;

 --Get the ABO description
 select abo_desc into szAboRh from vserv_abo where abo_code=szTestedAbo and rownum=1;

 select nvl(component_weight/1000,0) into szWeight from components where unit_id=unit_rec.unit_id and 
 product_code=unit_rec.product_code;

 
 szAbo:=RTrim(substr(szAboRh,1,instr(szAboRh,' ',1)));
 szRh:=RTrim(substr(szAboRh,instr(szAboRh,' ',1)+1,3));

 szUnitEle:='<Unit identifer='||'"'||unit_rec.unit_id||'"'||' collection_date='||'"'||to_char(unit_rec.coll_date,'yyyy-mm-dd')||'"'||' abo='||'"'||szAbo||'"'||
 ' rh='||'"'||szRh||'"'||' weight='||'"'||to_char(szweight)||'"'||' weight_unit='||'"kg"/>';

 szUnitEle:=Lpad(szUnitEle,NVL(Length(szUnitEle), 0)+13,'X');
 szUnitEle:=Translate(szUnitEle,'X',' ');
 Text_IO.Put_Line(in_file, szUnitEle);
 end loop;

 szCartonEndTag:='</Carton>';
 szCartonEndTag:=Lpad(szCartonEndTag,NVL(Length(szCartonEndTag), 0)+9,'X');
 szCartonEndTag:=Translate(szCartonEndTag,'X',' ');
 Text_IO.Put_Line(in_file, szCartonEndTag);

End Loop;

szShipEndTag:='</Shipment>';
szShipEndTag:=Lpad(szShipEndTag,NVL(Length(szShipEndTag), 0)+5,'X');
szShipEndtag:=Translate(szShipEndTag,'X',' ');
Text_IO.Put_Line(in_file, szShipEndTag);

szNoteEndTag:='</Note>';
--szNoteEndTag:=Lpad(szNoteEndTag,40,'X');
--szNoteEndtag:=Translate(szNoteEndTag,'X',' ');

Text_IO.Put_Line(in_file, szNoteEndTag);

 -- Text_IO.PUTF (in_file, '%-18.18s %-6.6s %-8.8s %-4.4s %-15.15s', szInsertDats,szUserId,szProgramName,szErrorCode, szUnitId);
 -- Text_IO.PUTF (in_file, '%-9.9s %-4.4s %-2.2s %-8.8s\n',szCollDate,szChapterId,szCompPrefix,szProductCode );

 Text_IO.Fclose (in_file); 


EXCEPTION 

 WHEN others then
 Text_IO.Fclose (in_file); 
 message('Error:'||sqlerrm);pause; 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_S_SHIPMENT__LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT sh.shipment_no,
 sh.consignee_id,
 SUBSTR(co.name, 1, 30),
 TO_CHAR(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, sh.shipment_date), 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI')
FROM shipments sh, consignee co
WHERE sh.shipment_status != 'OP'
AND sh.shipment_type = 'RE'
AND co.consignee_id = sh.consignee_id
AND co.customer_id IN
 (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE edn_gen_flag = 'Y'
 )
AND lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE) BETWEEN co.eff_date AND NVL(co.term_date, sysdate + 365)
AND sh.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id
AND co.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id
ORDER BY sh.shipment_date DESC
